name: dev-pipeline
description: Autonomous ticket-to-PR pipeline across intake → build → review → merge-boundary blocks, gated by five artifact milestones — a thin scheduler (/dev-pipeline:run) over payload blocks that stay individually invokable (/dev-pipeline:build, /dev-pipeline:review). Portable merge-boundary evidence, tracker adapters (github|jira), Workflow-based review/mutation gates, cost tracking, retro. Reads per-repo static context from .claude/second-shift.config.json.
